input.summary: Add Company convenience termination on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and bar Contractor convenience termination while a Statement of Work is outstanding.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 6(a) only permits convenience termination when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so we have no exit once an engagement starts. We added a Company convenience right on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and confirmed Contractor cannot walk away mid-engagement.

ops.text: Company may also terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any or no reason upon thirty (30) days advance written notice to Contractor, in which case Contractor shall refund any prepaid fees pro rata for the period after the effective date of such termination. Contractor may not terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience while any Statement of Work is outstanding.
